name: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd. engages in the provision, development, and production of advanced medical imaging solutions, radiotherapy equipment, life science instruments, and intelligent digital solutions worldwide. The company provides molecular imaging products; and magnetic resonance imaging solutions. It also offers computed tomography equipment; digital radiography equipment; mammography equipment; angiography equipment; mobile C-arm equipment; and radiotherapy systems comprising uRT-linac 506c, uRT-linac 306, and Intelligent RT Cloud Ecosystem.
